title: Home Theater Installation in Fresno | Reliant Electrical and Automation Inc.

hero.sub: Acoustic tuning, high-resolution picture and sound, and streaming with no lag. One licensed team handles the design, the wiring, and the installation.

cards.h2: What a home theater is made of

items.p: 5.1, 7.1, 7.2, and up to 15.1. The layout follows the room, the seats, and how you want to hear it.
Hidden in the walls and ceiling, placed for sightlines and tuned to the room. Nothing on the floor.
Balanced cable runs, dedicated circuits, grounding, and surge protection. The sound stays clean and the electronics stay safe.

about.p: Reliant Electrical and Automation started on the docks and in industrial corridors, wiring vessels and running sound for live shows. That background in power and mission-critical systems is what we bring to every theater: a system that is invisible but intelligent, reliable day after day, and simple for the people who use it.

items.p: I hired Reliant Electrical and Automation Inc. to rewire my home in Fresno (a craftsman-style 2 bed, 1.5 bath built in 1941). The original wiring was knob and tube, which I discovered wouldn’t be covered by insurance in the event of an electrical claim.

Great work! Marshal (Reliant Electrical & Automation Inc.) quickly figured out the reason that our main garage light socket was no longer turning the lightbulb on/off (wall switches for it were bad and needed to be replaced).

I’m very satisfied with Reliant Electrical’s work at my house. I hired them to replace our ceiling fans. Both Marshal and Evan had done an outstanding job. They’re courteous, tidy, punctual, and very competent. I highly recommend Reliant Electrical’s service.👍

items.q: What does a home theater include?
items.a: A display or a projector and screen, surround or Atmos-style audio, seating, acoustic panels, lighting control, and one remote or touch panel that runs it all.

items.q: Can a theater go into an existing home?
items.a: In most cases, yes. We check electrical capacity, network readiness, and access for new wiring, then plan the room around what is there.

items.q: Is it better to plan it during construction or a remodel?
items.a: Yes. Wiring and conduit go in while the walls are open, which avoids wall damage later and keeps future options open.

items.q: Will the system be hard to use?
items.a: No. Well-designed systems run on presets, so one button starts movie night. Simple controls are there when you want to adjust something.

items.q: Do you work in Clovis and Madera?
items.a: Yes. We install home theaters throughout Fresno, Clovis, Madera, and the surrounding Fresno County communities.

steps.p: We meet in the room, measure it, and talk through seating, sightlines, ambient light, and what you want it to do.
Speaker placement, the display or screen, dedicated circuits, and the wiring layout on paper before the walls close.
We select and source the gear to match the room and the plan, and work around your carpentry and drywall trades.
Installed, programmed, and tuned to the room, with a cleanup and a walkthrough so you know every button.

final.p: Tell us about the room and pick a time.

items.p: Wired and wireless coverage that keeps 4K streams and the control system steady.
Scenes, dimming, and keypads for the theater and the whole house.
Lights, climate, shades, and entertainment under one control.
Battery backup and generators that keep the house running through an outage.
